main.description: A night a party puts on, identified by its key in the party's space: two events can share a name. Written only by the Local Network root account, into the party's space, for its people with events.manage or for staff.

langs.description: The languages the description is written in.

startsAt.description: With the venue's UTC offset, so the venue's clock reads from it, or a draft's timeZone's while it has no venue. Only a draft can be without it.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone, like Europe/Berlin, that a draft without a venue keeps its times on. Once there's a venue, its clock takes over and this goes.

venue.description: The venue's space. Only a draft can be without it.

audience.description: public: anyone sees it. private: only someone with its link, and it's never listed.

linkToken.description: What a private event's link carries, so only someone given the link opens it. A new one stops the old link working.

publishedAt.description: When it was published. Absent while it's a draft, which only its party's people and staff see.

credit.description: A performer on the lineup, with their set times when they're known.

performer.description: A DJ's profile or an act's listing.
